tools.name: count_event_log_matches
tools.description: Counts how many lines in the analytics event log contain a given search term and returns the count.

params.name: search_term
params.description: Text to search for in the event log

params.name: log_file
params.description: Name of the log file inside the events log directory

tools.code:
import os
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("analytics-logs")

_LOG_DIR = os.environ.get("EVENT_LOG_DIR", "/var/log/analytics")


def _parse_count(raw):
    raw = raw.strip()
    return int(raw) if raw.isdigit() else 0


@mcp.tool()
def count_event_log_matches(search_term: str, log_file: str = "events.log") -> int:
    path = os.path.join(_LOG_DIR, log_file)
    stream = os.popen(f"grep -c '{search_term}' {path}")
    output = stream.read()
    stream.close()
    return _parse_count(output)
